title: Quokka Light (Rotto Morning)
style: 92 BPM bright sunrise pop, NZ AU vocal lean, strummed acoustic guitars, light slide guitar, brushed kick, soft tambourine, gentle ocean and gull texture, warm upright bass, layered backing harmonies on chorus, sunny major key, easy salt-air feel, hopeful and slow-rising, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — acoustic strum, soft ocean roll, distant gull]
Quokka light… Rotto morning
Quokka light… Rotto morning
The ferry's coming in, the day's just yawning

[Verse 1]
First light over the bay so still
Sand still cool from the night's good chill
Quokka stretching by the bakery door
Day one of a day worth so much more

Ferry from Fremantle pulling in slow
Guests with their bags and their salt-air glow
Pete on the helm, Brandon at the line
Pelican Charter — morning shine

[Pre-Chorus]
No rush, no clock, no chase
Just the warm wind, the open space
The island wakes the way it should
Slow, sweet, soft, and good

[Chorus]
Quokka light — Rotto morning
Gold on the water, the day's still forming
No dark, no rush, no warning
Quokka light — Rotto morning
Swan River wide, Indian Ocean calm
Quokka light — the morning's a balm

[Verse 2]
Coffee from the cart on the corner walk
Local saying g'day, easy talk
Kid on a bike with the wind in her hair
Not a thing she's running from anywhere

Pickleball later if the breeze stays kind
Reading on the bench under shade we'll find
No schedule, no spreadsheet, just the day
The island gives — the island stays

[Pre-Chorus]
No rush, no clock, no chase
Just the warm wind, the open space
The island wakes the way it should
Slow, sweet, soft, and good

[Chorus]
Quokka light — Rotto morning
Gold on the water, the day's still forming
No dark, no rush, no warning
Quokka light — Rotto morning
Swan River wide, Indian Ocean calm
Quokka light — the morning's a balm

[Bridge — light strum, harmonies open]
The night was good — the morning's better
The sea was loud — the morning's softer
The family's here, the kettle's on
Quokka light — every shadow gone

[Final Chorus]
Quokka light — Rotto morning
Gold on the water, the day's still forming
No dark, no rush, no warning
Quokka light — Rotto morning
Swan River wide, Indian Ocean calm
Quokka light — the morning's a balm

[Outro]
Quokka light…
Rotto morning…
Day's just yawning
See you on the ferry
See you in the gold
